propositions: The fixture equivalence test incorrectly required build_ticket_position_commit_map to succeed on first attempt despite the source contract explicitly returning empty map on any Git transient and production callers falling back per-event.

Runtime injection of rc 128/empty, rc 0/empty, and BlockingIOError(EAGAIN) each reproduced the observed sequence of first empty batched result followed immediately by successful identical replay in unchanged repository.
The prior loose-object ENOENT hypothesis was refuted: deleting the implicated loose blob left both broad and narrow git-log history reads healthy in the real fixture repository.

Fixture-only bounded recovery (_fixture_batched_map) performs at most five exact resolver attempts, returns on first complete map, and raises with fsck/count-objects diagnostics on persistent failure; no production authorship source behavior changed.
Both direct equivalence assertions and optimization-count assertion must use the same bounded recovery seam to isolate test determinism from documented transient Git-read boundaries.
